subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

One who makes an active effort to promote human welfare
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e.** 'Philanthropist'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate **word for "one who makes an active effort to promote human welfare" is:** 'Philanthropist'.**
 
• A **"Philanthropist" **is a person who seeks to promote the welfare of others, often through the donation of money, resources, or time to good causes.(परोपकारी)

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: *'Philanthropist'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Feminist:** A feminist is a person who believes in and advocates for the rights and equality of women.(नारीवादी).
 
• **Sexist:** A sexist person discriminates based on gender, particularly against women. (लिंग-पक्षपाती).
 
• **Misogynist:** A misogynist is someone who dislikes, despises, or is strongly prejudiced against women. (नारी द्वेषी).
